tools.name: find_road_trips
tools.description: Search Roadcut's European road trip itineraries by country, number of days or keywords (e.g. "fjords", "Alps", "coast", a town). Returns matching trips with days, km and a link.

tools.name: get_road_trip
tools.description: Day-by-day overview of one Roadcut road trip: from, to, km and where to sleep each day, highlights, ferries, seasonal mountain passes on the way, a cost estimate, and links to the full plan and the interactive planner. A trip is identified by its slug.

tools.name: get_driving_rules
tools.description: Speed limits, drink-driving limit and winter tyre, stud and chain rules for a European country, each with the official sources and the date Roadcut last checked them.

tools.name: get_mountain_pass
tools.description: When a European mountain pass (Alps, Norway, Carpathians…) usually opens and closes, whether it opened this year, night closures, and where the road operator publishes live status. Search by pass name or country. Seasons are records of past years, not live status; each result links to the operator's
